prompt: Convert exported Figma login-card JSON into production-ready SwiftUI views with real colors, fonts, layout, and a tokens file.

assertions.text: Emits a separate design-tokens file with Color(red:..) tokens
Uses VStack for the vertical auto-layout
Preserves text content ('Welcome back' and 'Sign In')
Captures card sizing: 320pt width, 16pt corner radius, drop shadow
Upgrades the email RECTANGLE into a real TextField
View references named color tokens rather than only inline Color literals
